text.description_html:
PDQ 6200V605 Polished Brass Heavy Duty Vertical Rod Exit Device

Polished Brass heavy duty surface vertical rod exit device for use on medium and high traffic commercial, hospitality, institutional applications. Suitable for all doors (aluminum, hollow metal, or wood), durable enough for the most demanding applications.

For 30" - 36" Wide Doors, furnished standard with sex nuts. Listed by U.L./U.L.C. and comply with U.L. 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. Non-handed. reversible for left or right hand doors. Polished Brass finish.

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings. Compliant with the 2014 Florida Building Code, which include a High Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) Product Approval: FL 21376 (65.0 PSF for paris of doors (6' x 7'))

Specifications for PDQ 6200V605 Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Chassis: Corrosion resistant plated steel
  • Rail: Extruded aluminum
  • Backset: 2-3/4" backset, compatible with 161 prep.
  • Top Latch Bolt: Pullman with dead latching 5/8" throw
  • Bottom Latch Bolt: Pullman with 5/8" throw, held retracted during door swing.
  • Projection: 3-1/8” projection / 1-5/8” projection when dogged
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging
  • Application: Surface Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Stile Width: 4-1/4" maximum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: Standard 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door.
  • Certifications: U.L./U.L.C. listed for “Panic” hardware labeled for up to 3 hour for 4’0” x 8’0” maximum single, 8’0” x 8’0” maximum pairs / Complies with U.L. 10C and UBC 7.2 (1997). ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices.
  • Warranty: Ten (10) year limited manufacture warranty mechanical components
  • PDQ 6200V Installation Template (PDF)
